Publication.Title: Fundamentals of Cellular and Molecular Biology
Publication.Abstract: This chapter of "Fundamentals of Cellular and Molecular Biology" provides a comprehensive overview of key concepts, including cell structure, function, and genetic mechanisms. It explores the foundational principles of molecular interactions, biochemical pathways, and cellular processes. By elucidating these core topics, the chapter aims to enhance understanding of how cells operate and communicate, forming the basis of life's biological complexity.
